d:
The 76ers defeated the Raptors, 123-112 tonight in Philadelphia. Tyrese Maxey contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 8 assists 2 rebounds and 2 steals, with Joel Embiid of the 76ers adding an additional 20 points (7-17 FG) in the game. RJ Barrett finished with a team-high 31 points along with 14 rebounds for the Raptors in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 10-3 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-7 for the season.
